rules.description: Preserve event and lot evidence for qualified review; never infer viability or automatically discard.

provenance.note: CDC documentation concepts only. Physical response, actual product guidance, and disposition remain outside the file workflow.

rules.description: Require the exact supplied schema, UTC seconds, integer temperatures, and bounded raw rows/derived pairs. Invalid packets reject explicitly.

provenance.note: Developer fixture validation and hard ceilings, not regulatory limits.

rules.description: Collapse exact repeated rows, retain multiplicity and variant counts, quarantine conflicting primary-key evidence, and expose future/orphan sources.

provenance.note: No first-wins or fabricated replacement data; unchanged source input remains trace-bound.

rules.description: Join each product's mock inclusive temperature profile; missing profile gives unknown duration, never a default 2-8 C band.

provenance.note: All fixture bands are invented, not actual product instructions.

rules.description: Half-open occupancy and evidence intervals; bounded zero-order hold only when the whole original point gap is within the supplied maximum.

provenance.note: Modeled duration is not measured exposure; excessive gaps are wholly unknown.

rules.description: Preserve missing assignment/calibration/reading coverage as unknown; conflicting attribution quarantines the lot's occupied union with null outside duration.

provenance.note: Unknown is never zero, normal conditions, or permission to release.

rules.description: Only assigned in-occupancy points flag outside-band; endpoints are inclusive in the band and exclusive at occupancy/window end. Predecessors can support covered time.

provenance.note: Explicit sampling/interval semantics; no clinical implication.

rules.description: Conserve covered plus unknown occupancy seconds and count each reviewed lot's quantity once; unresolved quantity yields a null total.

provenance.note: Inventory count is neither doses administered nor a loss/disposal estimate.

rules.description: Write the complete ordered packet and one draft request per flagged lot; correspondence never authorizes action.

provenance.note: No physical actions, notifications, or quality disposition; actual native execution is separately blocked.

steps.title: Load bounded mock exports
steps.procedure: Read explicit window, policy and table counts without changing the input.

steps.title: Validate exported evidence
steps.procedure: Check schema, exact types and UTC dates, hard ceilings and raw duplicates/conflicting keys.

steps.title: Join lots, profiles and occupancy
steps.procedure: Join inventory, product profiles, placements, unit assignments and sensor evidence; preserve missing references.

steps.title: Intersect exported evidence intervals
steps.procedure: Construct actual half-open interval intersections, respecting the full-gap limit and derived-pair bound.

steps.title: Assess each mock profile
steps.procedure: Classify covered intervals and attributable point observations against inclusive product-specific bands.

steps.title: Expose unknown and conflicting evidence
steps.procedure: Keep gaps distinct from zero and quarantine ambiguous lots without choosing a sensor, location or profile.

steps.title: Reconcile unique inventory and time
steps.procedure: Conserve durations, deduplicate quantity contributions and attach eligible correspondence evidence.

steps.title: Write draft quality-review packet
steps.procedure: Return all ordered business outputs, exceptions and draft requests with no-physical-action/quality-review boundaries.
